objective: Generate musically compelling, controllable music through one Rust composition algebra. Establish a comprehensive composable musical ontology first, before extending composition or inference.

checkpoint.summary: The ontology now separates arbitrary logarithmic pitch coordinates, basis, acoustic reference and optional repetition. Exact and approximate scalars are shared by tuning and independent spectra. Explicit scale-degree bindings and conditioned spectral correspondences preserve identity and context; a coordinated warp control establishes partial alignment without claiming a roughness optimum. This remains representation work with the existing compiler as sole note emitter.
nextActions: Review the parameterized coordinate model and spectral correspondence on concrete musical examples. Retain arbitrary bases, independent reference Hz, optional periods, unsorted/unbounded coordinates and exact or approximate inputs without silent normalization.
Keep all indexed LilyPond glossary headwords mapped, canonical aliases inspectable, cultural extensions qualified and parameterized concepts distinct from names.
When composition work is requested, lower a small useful set of these components through CompositionPlan and prove shared/local edits on complete passages.
Judge later progress by audition and useful composition across varied musical languages. Artist references guide musical goals, never hard-coded identities or fixed phrase lengths.

tasks.title: Review composable musical vocabulary and relationships
tasks.nextAction: Use the generalized coordinate, spectrum and correspondence types to state complete musical intentions. Next evaluate shared generator coordinates, typed trajectories and resource-specific realization where they simplify a concrete composition task; do not add a universal parameter graph.

tasks.title: Make chosen musical intentions executable
tasks.nextAction: After the ontology step, choose a bounded combination of rhythmic material, pitch binding, voicing and expressive technique. Lower through the existing compiler and fail explicitly for unsupported realization; add no parallel decoder.

tasks.title: Develop and audition complete editable passages
tasks.nextAction: Demonstrate recognizable ideas, contrasting continuations, independent orchestration and useful shared/local edits. Evaluate listening quality separately from exact reconstruction and ontology coverage.

tasks.title: Infer reusable structure when composition needs it
tasks.nextAction: Use executable forward structures to frame complete-passage inverse tests with exact observations, explicit alternatives and counterfactual edits. Retain harmony benchmarks as diagnostics; resume calibration only when a concrete composition capability needs it. Preserve whole-work holdouts.
